simpleshops.guide.page.1.title: Simple Shops
simpleshops.guide.page.1: Player shops: a Sales Block with a price and a Display Case with up to five goods, protected from strangers and explosions. Buyers swap price items for one piece per trade.
simpleshops.guide.page.2.title: Display Case
simpleshops.guide.page.2: A glass case with five goods slots that shows what is for sale. It only stands on a Sales Block of the same owner. Craft: 3 iron nuggets, 3 glass, 3 planks.
simpleshops.guide.page.3.title: Display Case
simpleshops.guide.page.3: The Glow Display Case (Display Case + glow ink sac, shapeless) draws the goods fully bright and gives off weak light (6).
simpleshops.guide.page.4.title: Sales Block
simpleshops.guide.page.4: The cash register of a shop: a wooden block under the Display Case. One price per Sales Block, up to five price items, plus 27 slots for the earnings. Craft: 6 planks, 2 iron ingots, 1 chest. Its owner is the player who placed it.
simpleshops.guide.page.5.title: Buying
simpleshops.guide.page.5: Click the Display Case or the Sales Block: pick a goods stack, put the price items into the pay slots (same positions
simpleshops.guide.page.6.title: Buying
simpleshops.guide.page.6: as the price row) and press Trade. One piece of the chosen goods per trade; shift-click repeats while price, goods and room last.
simpleshops.guide.page.7.title: Server shop
simpleshops.guide.page.7: An unlimited shop that only operators (permission level 2) create and configure with /servershop. Everybody, operators included, buys from it in the normal buyer menu.
simpleshops.guide.page.8.title: Protection
simpleshops.guide.page.8: A placed shop belongs to its owner (the player who placed it, saved by UUID on the server). Only the owner
simpleshops.guide.page.9.title: Protection
simpleshops.guide.page.9: and operators (permission level 2) can break it; the owner always can, also in a foreign claim and after claim rights changed.
simpleshops.guide.page.10.title: Claims and Simple Money
simpleshops.guide.page.10: Standalone, a shop works everywhere. With claims (Simple Tweaks) a shop can only be placed where its owner may build (build right B); buying needs no right at all.
simpleshops.guide.page.11.title: Settings
simpleshops.guide.page.11: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
